subject: SOC2 / SIG: VM forensic snapshot & remediation witness plan
messages:
From: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@acmepay.com>
To: sergio_alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.example.com>
Cc: audits@northconsulting.com
Date: 2027-05-08T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Request: artifacts & witness for recent CVE closure (SOC2/SIG)

Hi Sergio —

As part of our upcoming SOC2 evidence review (SIG reviewers included), we need a compact, auditable package for the recent CVE closures you provided on 2027-05-07. Specifically AcmePay auditors asked for: 

- A step-by-step forensic snapshot procedure used for any hotpatches (so they can reproduce the state)
- The hotpatch manifest with checksums and evidence of deployment windows (who triggered the patch, scheduler logs)
- Raw vulnerability scan output (machine-readable) for the affected images/hosts
- CVE closure attestation signed by an authorized Redwood engineer with timestamps
- A Plan for an on-site/remote witness (48hr window preferred) where an AcmePay/North Consulting engineer can observe the remediation/restart and confirm checksums

Can you confirm whether these artifacts are available and provide an estimated delivery plus a proposed witness window next week? We try to keep artifact retention queries short — auditors will want confirmation of retention policy for the artifacts (how long they will be stored).

Thanks,
Alice Nguyen
Security Lead, AcmePay
From: sergio_alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.example.com>
To: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@acmepay.com>
Cc: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.example.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.example.com>
Date: 2027-05-08T10:25:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: artifacts & witness for recent CVE closure (SOC2/SIG)

Alice — thanks for the clear list. We can provide everything you enumerated. High level response and next steps: 

- Forensic snapshot procedure: we have a concise runbook and an automated snapshot script (controls and checksum steps). Kimberly will attach the markdown runbook and S3 path.
- Hotpatch manifest: we’ll export the deployment manifest with SHA256 checksums and the operator identity for each patch.
- Raw VM scan output: we keep the NDJSON export and the normalized scan report for auditors.
- Signed attestation: we will produce a PDF attestation (signed by a security manager) with timestamps and reference to the ticket and deploy id.
- Witness window: proposed 2027-05-10 09:00–17:00 PDT (we can extend to 48-hour window if needed). Please confirm if that works for North Consulting.

Deliverables ETA: draft bundle by EOD 2027-05-09, final signed attestation by 2027-05-11 after the witness session.

I’ll coordinate the artifact hand-off and share links+access controls. If auditors need a live session rather than recorded, we can run the snapshot in staging with read-only access for the witness.

Best,
Sergio Alvarez
Head of Sales Engineering (VM & Compliance), Redwood Inference
From: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.example.com>
To: sergio_alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.example.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.example.com>, Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@acmepay.com>
Date: 2027-05-09T07:14:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: artifacts & witness for recent CVE closure (SOC2/SIG)

Hi all — adding technical details and artifact locations so auditors have what they need. Short summary: 

Artifacts prepared (attached / links below):
- hotpatch_manifest_20270507.csv (columns: deploy_id, operator, target_instance, package_version, sha256, start_ts, end_ts)
- vm-scan-20270430.ndjson (raw Nessus/OSV export, normalized tokens)
- forensic-snapshot-instructions.md (runbook for snapshot + reconstruction steps)
- cve-2027-0421-closure-attestation.pdf (signed by Laura Bennet, Security Manager)

Retention & provenance:
- Snapshot artifacts and raw scans are retained for 365 days by default in our audit bucket (s3://redwood-audit/acmepay/forensics/2027-05-07/). Access is limited to the security team and the requestor via pre-signed URLs for 7 days.
- We maintain immutable checksums and a signed S3 manifest for provenance.

For the live witness: the staging replay approach we suggested will run the same package + configuration used in prod but in an isolated VPC (no customer traffic). During the witness we will: 
1) run the snapshot script (forensic-snapshot-instructions.md) to capture memory, process list, and kernel modules (where appropriate)
2) publish checksums to the manifest and S3
3) run the same vuln-scan command against the staging image and compare results to the exported NDJSON

Access: I’ll provide a pre-signed URL to the audit bundle and a Zoom link for the witness session.

Attachments: hotpatch_manifest_20270507.csv; vm-scan-20270430.ndjson; forensic-snapshot-instructions.md

-Kim
Kimberly Park
Security Engineering Manager, Redwood Inference
From: audits@northconsulting.com <audits@northconsulting.com>
To: sergio_alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.example.com>, kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.example.com>, Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@acmepay.com>
Date: 2027-05-10T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: artifacts & witness for recent CVE closure (SOC2/SIG)

Thanks — confirms receipt. North Consulting can attend the proposed witness window on 2027-05-10 09:00–17:00 PDT. A couple of clarifications before the session: 

- We prefer the 48-hour window when possible; can you extend the witness availability to 2027-05-10 09:00 through 2027-05-11 17:00 PDT to accommodate timezone overlaps for our EU team?
- For the signed attestation we will need a DocuSign-hosted signature or equivalent audit-grade signature (a simple PDF signed by a manager is acceptable only if it includes identity, role, and signing time in RFC3339).
- Please provide explicit ACL matrix for who will be added to the pre-signed URLs (emails) so we can confirm access ahead of time.

If you can update the bundle with those items we’ll review prior to the witness session and share any quick follow-ups in the morning (2027-05-10).

Regards,
North Consulting SOC2 Team
From: sergio_alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.example.com>
To: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@acmepay.com>, audits@northconsulting.com <audits@northconsulting.com>
Cc: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.example.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.example.com>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.example.com>
Date: 2027-05-11T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: artifacts & witness for recent CVE closure (SOC2/SIG) — confirmation & access

All — quick confirmation and inventory of what we’ll hand over prior to the witness session: 

1) Audit bundle (pre-signed URL valid 7 days): https://redwood-internal.example.com/drive/AcmePay/forensics/2027-05-07 (will share pre-signed link in separate secure email)
2) DocuSign attestation link: https://docusign.example.com/12345-closure-attestation (Laura will sign by 2027-05-11 18:00 PDT)
3) Extended witness window: confirmed 2027-05-10 09:00 PDT — 2027-05-11 17:00 PDT (48h span)
4) ACL matrix for pre-signed URL: alice.nguyen@acmepay.com; audits@northconsulting.com; j.martin@acmepay.com (read-only)
5) Artifacts attached in draft: hotpatch_manifest_20270507.csv; vm-scan-20270430.ndjson; forensic-snapshot-instructions.md

Next steps: I’ll send the pre-signed URL and the DocuSign envelope. Ben, can you be on the witness call as the deployments lead? Kim and Laura will own the artifact explanations.

Thanks — see you on the session,
Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Head of Sales Engineering (VM & Compliance), Redwood Inference
